s1.syndrome_frame: Malignant pleural disease with distant metastasis
salient_findings: Multiple pleural thickenings and marked effusion on the left side
Nodular growth on the mid third of the tongue
Epithelioid solid formations with pseudopapillary structures
key_facts: 62-year-old nonsmoking man
Multiple pleural thickenings and marked effusion on the left side
Underwent first-line chemotherapy followed by left pleurectomy
Postsurgical assessment revealed residual microscopic disease
External beam radiotherapy was administered
Disease remained stable until July 2023
Nodular growth appeared on the mid third of the tongue
Immunoreactive for calretinin, AE1/AE3, D2-40, Wilms tumor protein 1
Absence of nuclear staining for BRCA1-associated protein 1
Negative for methylthioadenosine phosphorylase
Homozygous deletion of CDKN2A gene by fluorescent in-situ hybridization

Solitary fibrous tumor of the tongue
per_call: Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura

shortlist.label: Malignant pleural mesothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Immunoreactive for calretinin and presence of epithelioid cells

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic malignant mesothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Pleural thickenings and marked effusion, consistent with aggressive mesothelioma subtype

shortlist.label: Biphasic malignant mesothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Microscopic assessment showing epithelioid and sarcomatoid components

shortlist.label: Epithelioid malignant mesothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Dominant epithelioid cell type and calretinin positivity

shortlist.label: Peritoneal malignant mesothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Less likely but possible given the presence of metastasis and mesothelial origin

raw.rationale: The patient's disease is characterized by epithelioid solid formations with pseudopapillary structures, and the tumor cells are immunoreactive for calretinin, AE1/AE3, D2-40, and Wilms tumor protein 1, which are typical features of epithelioid malignant mesothelioma

rejected.label: Malignant pleural mesothelioma
rejected.why: Too general, as it encompasses multiple subtypes

rejected.label: Desmoplastic malignant mesothelioma
rejected.why: Not supported by the presence of epithelioid solid formations

rejected.label: Biphasic malignant mesothelioma
rejected.why: No evidence of both epithelioid and sarcomatoid components

rejected.label: Peritoneal malignant mesothelioma
rejected.why: The disease is primarily located in the pleura, not the peritoneum
